section.description: Four simple steps from upload to mailing

steps.title: Upload Your PDFs
steps.description: Drag-and-drop your documents into our secure dashboard. Same-day or next-day mailing available.

steps.title: Address Verification
steps.description: NCOA/CASS verification updates addresses before mailing, reducing returned letters by 40%.

steps.title: We Print & Process
steps.description: Professional printing, folding, stuffing into envelopes, and sealing—all automated.

steps.title: USPS Mailing & Tracking
steps.description: Same-day or next-day mailing. Track Priority and Certified letters through delivery.

section.title: The Postalocity Difference
section.description: Discover why businesses trust our mailing service

differences.title: Every Mailer Includes an Envelope
differences.description: We use real envelopes—not loose paper sealed with a sticker. Every statement is professionally printed, folded, stuffed into an envelope, sealed, and mailed.

differences.title: Mail Visibility
differences.description: Tracking available on Priority Mail and Certified Mail. First-Class Mail (standard) does not include tracking. Signature tracking on Certified Mail available for additional fee.

differences.title: Skip USPS Drop Boxes & Cutoffs
differences.description: Bypass post office drop-off times and waiting in line. We automate the process—eliminating missed cutoffs and potentially days in delivery time.
